description:
Isik University has strengthened since its establishment in 1996. It has been serving with 35 undergraduate programs, five faculties, 21 associate degree programs, 2 Vocational Schools, Institute of Social Sciences and Applied Sciences, School of Foreign Languages ​​, and Continuing Education Center.

Isik University has established two campuses in Sile and Maslak with modern infrastructure, classrooms, dormitories, libraries, social and sports facilities of 490.000 m2 in a natural environment close to everyday city life to meet today's needs. An art gallery. Faculty of Fine Arts, Vocational Schools, Continuing Education Center, Institute of Social Sciences, and Institute of Applied Sciences in Maslak Campus; All other faculties and departments are located in Sile Campus.

Isik University conducts its education on two fully functional campuses.

Located away from the city center, the university is built on a large area that allows various recreational activities. Located close to the beautiful beaches of Sile, the campus offers Isik University students the opportunity to do water sports, trekking, climbing, rafting, and cycling tours.

Sile Campus serves a 24/7 life with its dormitories, gyms, a 24-hour library, medical center and cafeterias, computer laboratories, markets, and restaurants. The campus also offers students a rich recreational and cultural life with concerts, festivals, galleries, seminars, and other events.
